subject: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@cloudforge.io>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@cloudforge.io
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment

Hi Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudForge is kicking off an ISV+SI pilot where we bundle Redwood-powered inference into our managed offering for select enterprise customers. A couple of things came up in our internal go/no-go checklist that we need your help with before we can complete the marketplace pre-listing: 

1) Entitlement mapping: our billing model bills per-seat + a shared inference pool. The marketplace standard maps to a per-instance SKU which will cause double-billing for our customers. We would like an exemption that allows a single marketplace SKU to represent a pooled billing arrangement for the pilot.

2) Technical gating: we need confirmation on whether Redwood supports streaming tokens for long-running conversations (>8k tokens) and whether there are recommended model variants for lower-latency inference in a multitenant SI setup.

3) Timeline: the pilot onboarding window is the week of June 19 — can we get a lightweight MOP and an ETA for any exemption approvals and a short joint rollout plan?

I attached our integration spec and a short outline of the pilot. Happy to jump on a 30 minute call if that helps.

Attachments: cloudforge-integration-specs.pdf

Best,
Asha Rao
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge
asha@cloudforge.io
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@cloudforge.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Tagging the right folks from our side.

Quick responses:
- Commercial/exemption ask: Marissa, can you confirm the commercial approach and internal approval path for a pooled billing SKU exemption?
- Technical gating: Karthik, please review the attached spec and advise whether we need a temporary model variant or a config flag to support the pilot.
- Timeline: Laura and I can support a June 19 pilot kickoff if approvals land by the end of next week (June 1). If not, we should aim for the first week of July.

Asha — would you be able to share a brief sample of the traffic profile (QPS, typical request/response size) and an example contract clause that shows how you represent the pooled billing to customers? That will speed approvals.

I put a short proposed MAP in thread for review — if everyone is aligned I can convert to a spreadsheet and start the approvals flow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment

Folks — I reviewed CloudForge's spec (nice doc). High-level technical asks and blockers from product/infra: 

- Streaming + long contexts: Redwood runtime supports streaming and KV cache for long-context flows, but for >8k token sessions we recommend using the low-latency model variants (rwd-ll-7b-ql8 or rwd-ml-13b-ql4) depending on quality needs. We'll need to pin model variants for the pilot to ensure predictable SLAs.

- Multitenant isolation: For an SI-managed pool, we need the following from CloudForge: tenant id header in every request (x-cf-tenant), and a rate-limited routing policy per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbor issues. We can provide a config example.

- Auth & billing events: Expose request-level usage events (token counts per request) via the events API so your billing system can reconcile. If you cannot accept per-request events, we can support aggregated hourly usage dumps, but that will complicate entitlement mapping.

- Pilot telemetry: we need a representative traffic sample (7 days preferred). Asha, if you can share a 48–72 hour sample now we can scope the autoscaling settings and batch sizes.

I'll draft a minimal model pinning proposal and share by EOD.

— Karthik
Product Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Rao <asha@cloudforge.io>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment

Thanks Karthik — that's very helpful. Attached is a 72-hour sample (anonymized) and a short snippet from our draft contract showing the pooled billing clause.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We can add x-cf-tenant headers for each request.
- For billing reconciliation we prefer hourly aggregated dumps in the first month of pilot, then switch to event-level once reconciliation is verified. Is that workable?
- For the marketplace listing exemption: we are asking that the marketplace SKU map to a single entitlement that covers the managed pool. We understand this is nonstandard — we are asking for a temporary exemption for the pilot only (90 days).

Attachments: sample-traffic-202805.zip

Would it help if we scheduled a 30 minute tech sync tomorrow (Thu) for model pinning and traffic sizing?

Best,
Asha Rao
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@cloudforge.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge SI onboarding: exemption requests & roadmap alignment

Asha / Ben — thanks for the sample. Commercial/marketplace notes: 

- We can support a 90-day temporary marketplace entitlement exemption for the pilot. That requires an internal marketplace exemption ticket, an acknowledgement from legal on T&Cs, and a simple MAP with milestones. I will open the exemption ticket today and loop Legal (this typically takes 4–7 business days).

- For billing we prefer you move to request-level events by month 2 of the pilot; aggregate hourly dumps for month 1 are acceptable for rollout. We will surface reconciliation gaps during week 2.

- Next steps: please confirm the pilot customer list (names only) and preferred pilot kickoff date. Ben, can you confirm ownership of the MAP? I can take the listing-side coordination.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CF-5012
DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/r/CF-5012/pilot-agreement

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

All — good progress. Confirming the mutual action plan and owners below (I will attach the working MAP spreadsheet):

2) Tech sync + model pinning (rwd-ll-7b-ql8 initial) — Owner: Karthik — Tech sync tomorrow 2028-05-25 09:00 PT

4) Pilot kickoff & monitoring runbook — Owner: Ben / CloudForge — Target: 2028-06-19

If that plan looks good to everyone, I'll convert MAP to our approval flow and ping Legal/Finance. Asha — confirm the pilot customer list in a quick reply and we will lock dates.

Thanks all,
Ben
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
